Zoology ( / z oʊ ˈ ɒ l ə dʒ i / zoh- OL -ə-jee , UK also / z u ˈ -/ zoo- ) [ 1 ] is the scientific study of animals . Its studies include the structure , embryology , classification , habits , and distribution of all animals, both living and extinct , and how they interact with their ecosystems . Zoology is one of the primary branches of biology . The term is derived from Ancient Greek ζῷον ( zôion ) ' animal ' and λόγος ( lógos ) ' study of ' . [ 2 ]
